overview.about: Hosted by Tiger Woods and his foundation, the Genesis Invitational is contested at Riviera Country Club near Los Angeles - the fabled 'Hogan's Alley', which opened in 1926. Kikuyu-grass fairways, sunken greens and an old-Hollywood pedigree make Riviera a layout the players revere, and its limited field ranks among the season's deepest.
overview.nextEvent: The next Genesis Invitational is played at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California. A limited-field signature event, it benefits the TGR Foundation and consistently attracts the game's biggest names.
